requirement: Maintain authorized resident access to hostel-owned sports equipment across 24/7 operating hours; do not require sports secretary attendance at each ordinary loan.
verification: Verify ordinary borrower journey outside secretary availability

requirement: Represent sports-room key custody and individual equipment custody as distinct events and records.
verification: Compare independent key and equipment histories for same session

requirement: Support overlapping room access without incorrectly attributing every item to the original key signer.
verification: Stage two students accessing room during one key checkout

requirement: Allow each durable item to be uniquely distinguished, without conflating asset model/type with individual identity.
verification: Register two same-model rackets and identify them unambiguously

requirement: Support quantity-based accounting for consumables and other interchangeable low-value stock, rather than mandatory one-code-per-unit tracking.
verification: Receive and consume a stock lot; reconcile units remaining

requirement: Represent a team kit as a container/manifest of individual assets and relevant stock quantities.
verification: Issue/return a kit with mixed contents and reconcile components

requirement: Record last-known location, custodian/responsible entity, condition, evidence source and timestamp separately for trackable items.
verification: Independently inspect each attribute and find missing, stale, inconsistent data

requirement: Make mutually exclusive operational availability classifications that do not double-count one physical item.
verification: Reconcile active and retired assets; assert state counts sum to census

requirement: Permit periodic physical census and discrepancy reconciliation without silently overwriting historical records.
verification: Reconcile audit differences; retain who/when/why for corrections

requirement: Check borrowing eligibility and current item suitability before committing a physical issue; record denials and unmet requests for fulfilment measurement.
verification: Request available, damaged and already-issued items; verify outcomes

requirement: Prevent one uniquely identified durable item from having two simultaneous active custody assignments or confirmed physical issues.
verification: Attempt two competing issues of one asset; exactly one may succeed

requirement: Distinguish a request, permission or reservation from actual item collection and physical handover.
verification: Approve request without item leaving; ensure custody unchanged until handover

requirement: Allow a student or accountable team/captain to hold a borrowing, with clear responsibility rules that do not automatically imply fault for damage.
verification: Borrow as individual and team, verify recorded responsible entity

requirement: Support proportionate custody updates for transfers away from the responsible group, while allowing ordinary on-ground sharing without mandatory per-touch logging until evaluated.
verification: Compare on-ground share and off-ground transfer tasks for record completeness and burden

requirement: Do not equate return of room key or a verbal declaration with verified return of a specific asset or kit components.
verification: Close key session with missing declared asset; equipment discrepancy must remain visible

requirement: Support partial kit return, missing component declaration and discrepancy resolution.
verification: Return kit missing one component; preserve unresolved status and actual counts

requirement: Preserve low-friction tournament borrowing with a defined captain or team workflow; do not require lengthy match-day item-by-item sign-in.
verification: Time captain kit checkout and verify exception traceability relative to comparator

requirement: Support risk-proportionate condition inspection/confirmation before marking returned equipment confidently usable; assignment of inspector remains a design decision.
verification: Pass/fail/unknown return inspection and measure effort

requirement: Prevent known damaged or explicitly quarantined equipment from being represented as verified usable stock.
verification: Try to issue quarantined asset; system must not claim it is verified usable

requirement: Distinguish damage discovery time from unknown damage occurrence time; do not impute culprit from last key sign-out.
verification: Create report with unknown event time and responsible party; do not auto-blame

requirement: Support structured damage reporting with item/group, description, source, evidence date and owner notification or acknowledgement.
verification: File complaint and verify actionable handoff to secretary

requirement: Represent repair workflow milestones separately: discovery, assessment, approval, vendor handoff, repair, receipt, and reinspection.
verification: Log mock repair case; calculate step and overall lead time without fabricated timestamps

requirement: Require a documented restoration decision/inspection before a repaired item can return to confidently usable status.
verification: Close repair without verification; asset must not show verified usable

requirement: Support retirement/write-off of unusable equipment with sports secretary authorization and an auditable reason, without altering official hostel policy.
verification: Retire asset by permitted role, verify removal from active inventory

requirement: Trace proposed need, quotation, approvals, payment, purchase and receipt as distinct procurement events.
verification: Follow synthetic purchase scenario through stages while preserving approvals

requirement: Honor hostel-controlled purchasing/repair authorizations and treat the reported INR 10000 purchase threshold as configurable until office policy is confirmed.
verification: Use both spending routes without automatic approval or policy hard-coding

requirement: Connect receipt of purchased durable items to inventory registration or consumable stock-lot adjustment; invoice alone cannot imply current usable stock.
verification: Receive invoice and physically confirm items; reconcile received against registered

requirement: Support transparent budget-priority considerations, including equipment condition, demand and hostel-office preferences, without encoding medals as the sole priority.
verification: Compare example priorities and show reasons and authorized override

requirement: Calculate strict verified accountability as audited eligible assets with independently correct recorded location, custody and condition divided by all audited eligible assets.
verification: Compute sample numerator and denominator, including unknown record fields

requirement: Report unassessable/unknown attributes separately from contradicted ones, with sample size, audit timestamp and sampling limitations.
verification: Score absent custodian vs wrong custodian differently without counting either verified

requirement: Report supporting category-normalized measures, e.g. fulfilment, unusable-stock share, repair lead time, time per task and record completeness, with correct denominators.
verification: Compare categories with unequal stock quantities; no raw totals substituted for rates

requirement: Measure additional user, guard and secretary interaction cost; do not assume a fully detailed event log is practical.
verification: Counterbalance comparable tasks and log task time, omissions and burden

requirement: Preserve a timestamped event/audit history for changes to physical custody, item condition, approvals and corrections.
verification: Correct a mistaken status without erasing earlier entry

requirement: Define a safe, auditable process for interrupted or offline updates; identify unresolved conflicts rather than silently accepting impossible state changes.
verification: Record offline transaction, reconcile collision with newer event

requirement: Restrict administrative and financial actions to authorized roles; minimize exposure of borrower information and avoid assuming the guard should operate all item workflows.
verification: Attempt unauthorized repair closure, retirement, invoice approval

requirement: Exclude identifiable student register data, signatures, ID-card images and private transactions from public repo and academic artifacts.
verification: Scan sample exported study artifacts for personal data and use anonymized counts

requirement: Compare candidate workflows with a consistent scenario set and record actual baseline/pilot outcomes separately from toy scenarios or estimates.
verification: Produce test report showing real vs synthetic provenance and matched task IDs

requirement: Document at least one evidence-based refinement after testing, or explain retention of first design using observed results.
verification: Show improvement hypothesis, version, result, retained or rejected change

requirement: Support simple operator training and visible recovery procedures, with no mandatory technological dependence before alternatives are evaluated.
verification: Give unfamiliar user a documented task without researcher assistance

requirement: Handle planned loans and overdue items without assuming hostel policy currently imposes a late-return fine.
verification: Exercise late return notification and no-auto-fine behavior
